name: Kirtland
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kirtland, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kirtland, Ohio for 2026: Lake Farmpark's Holiday Ice and Lights Festival, Country Lights Drive-Thru, Candy Land, a free Nativity exhibit and Christmas in Kirtland.
lede: Kirtland has Lake Metroparks Farmpark's ice carving and light displays, a free Nativity exhibit at the Kirtland Temple Visitors' Center and a Parade of Trees on the city's grounds.
celebrates: Lake Metroparks fills Kirtland with holiday events: the Holiday Ice & Lights Festival at Farmpark, the Country Lights Drive-Thru, and the indoor Candy Land Wild about Winter at Penitentiary Glen Reservation. Volunteers from The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints open the Historic Kirtland Nativity Exhibit at the Kirtland Temple Visitors' Center, and Kirtland Heritage Group runs Christmas in Kirtland with a Parade of Trees, Santa visits and library crafts.
lastyear: Kirtland Heritage Group's site shows photos of lighted arches over a snowy path and decorated trees from Christmas 2025. For 2026 the group lists a Parade of Trees with the lights on from November 22 to January 6, 2027, plus five family nights from November 30 to December 28.
facts: Country Lights Drive-Thru tickets are $27.50 per carload, sold online only, with a maximum of three carload tickets per household and evening times from 6 pm to 8:30 pm. Candy Land Wild about Winter is described by Lake Metroparks as a free family tradition and is closed on Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day. The Holiday Ice & Lights Festival says daily admission fees apply.
trains: Santa and his elves from the Northern Ohio Garden Railroad Society set up a North Pole Train Display in the Exhibit Hall during the Holiday Ice & Lights Festival at Farmpark, according to Lake Metroparks. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs its North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in Independence from November 13 to December 22, 2026, with 5:00 pm and 7:55 pm departures and tickets listed at $60 to $110 per person, according to the railroad. It is not in Kirtland, but it is a short drive away.
train_links: The railroad that runs the North Pole Adventure Christmas train from Rockside Station in Independence.
traditions: Ice carvers, Santa's ice throne, tractor-drawn wagon rides through the light displays and a North Pole Train Display at Farmpark.
A drive-through lights evening at Farmpark, with timed tickets and a carload price.
A free indoor wonderland with a craft, scavenger hunts and Wild Weekends at Penitentiary Glen.
Trees decorated by local businesses, families and groups, lit through January 6.
A free Nativity exhibit with opening night music and Christmas Music Nights.
kidfact: Santa has a throne made of ice at Farmpark's Holiday Ice & Lights Festival, and kids can sit on it.
faq: What is the best Christmas event for kids in Kirtland?

Lake Metroparks lists the Holiday Ice & Lights Festival at Farmpark with Santa's ice throne, ice carvers and a wagon ride through the lights, on November 27 to 29 and December 18 to 23 from 4 pm to 9 pm.
Are there free Christmas events in Kirtland?
Yes. Lake Metroparks calls Candy Land Wild about Winter a free family tradition, the Historic Kirtland Nativity Exhibit has free admission and Christmas in Kirtland says admission is free.
How much is Country Lights Drive-Thru?
$27.50 per carload, with advance tickets sold online only, on December 4 to 6, December 11 to 13 and December 26 and 27, according to Lake Metroparks.
Where is Candy Land Wild about Winter?
At Penitentiary Glen Reservation, 8668 Kirtland-Chardon Road, Kirtland, from November 21 to January 3, 10 am to 5 pm.
sources: Christmas in Kirtland and Parade of Trees
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kirtland for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Holiday Ice & Lights Festival) through January 3 (Candy Land Wild about Winter), with Historic Kirtland Nativity Exhibit (November 29), Christmas in Kirtland and Parade of Trees (November 30) and Country Lights Drive-Thru (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kirtland

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Kirtland
  • 3 free events, including Candy Land Wild about Winter, the Historic Kirtland Nativity Exhibit and Christmas in Kirtland and Parade of Trees
  • Meet Santa: Santa on a throne of ice at the Holiday Ice & Lights Festival (November 27 to 29 and December 18 to 23) and Christmas in Kirtland family nights
  • Lights: Country Lights Drive-Thru at Farmpark (December 4 to 6, 11 to 13, 26 and 27) and the Parade of Trees at Kirtland City Hall
  • Trains: the North Pole Train Display at the Holiday Ice & Lights Festival, and the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad from Rockside Station in Independence
  • Season: November 21 to January 3
